review: 604.2-1: variant opponent_controls_anthem flipped the outcome through the Anthem's own 'you control' wording, not through 604.2's source-on-battlefield condition; dropped it.

604.6-1: variant main2 left open whether a combat damage step had happened this turn (with no attackers it is skipped, making 'before the combat damage step' ambiguous); the delta now states that Grizzly Bears attacked and combat damage was dealt.

scenarios.title: A static ability's continuous effect lasts only while its source is on the battlefield
decisions: Both players pass priority with an empty stack; the board is read.

variants.label: anthem_on_battlefield
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 3/3 (Glorious Anthem gives creatures A controls +1/+1).

variants.label: anthem_in_graveyard
variants.delta: Glorious Anthem is in A's graveyard instead of on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: An Equipment's static ability modifies the object it is attached to and follows it when moved

setup.notes: Bonesplitter is attached to Grizzly Bears. The Mountain is untapped. Bonesplitter: equipped creature gets +2/+0; Equip {1}.

decisions: A activates Bonesplitter's equip ability targeting Runeclaw Bear, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; the equip ability resolves.

variants.label: moved
variants.expected: Bonesplitter is attached to Runeclaw Bear, which is 4/2; Grizzly Bears is back to 2/2.

variants.label: not_moved
variants.delta: A does not activate the equip ability; both players just pass priority.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 4/2; Runeclaw Bear is 2/2.

scenarios.title: A can't-be-countered static ability works while its spell is on the stack
decisions: A casts Abrupt Decay targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping Swamp and Forest.
B responds by casting Counterspell targeting Abrupt Decay, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Counterspell resolves, then (if still on the stack) Abrupt Decay resolves.

variants.label: abrupt_decay
variants.expected: Counterspell resolves but does not counter Abrupt Decay (it can't be countered); Abrupt Decay resolves and Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: terror
variants.delta: A casts Terror (paying Swamp and Forest) targeting Grizzly Bears instead of Abrupt Decay.
variants.expected: Counterspell counters Terror, which moves to A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: An alternative-cost static ability applies to a spell being cast

setup.notes: A has only the two lands listed. Gush costs {4}{U} normally, which A cannot pay; its alternative cost is to return two Islands A controls to hand.

decisions: A casts Gush, choosing to return two Islands A controls to hand rather than pay its mana cost.

variants.label: two_islands
variants.expected: Casting Gush is legal (can_play true) at no mana cost; both Islands return to A's hand and A draws two cards.

variants.label: one_island
variants.delta: A's battlefield is one Island and one Mountain instead of two Islands.
variants.expected: Casting Gush is illegal (can_play false): the alternative cost needs two Islands and the {4}{U} cost cannot be paid.

scenarios.title: A 'cast only before the combat damage step' static ability restricts casting from hand

setup.notes: Berserk: 'Cast this spell only before the combat damage step.' Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before this turn.

decisions: A casts Berserk targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest.

variants.label: main1
variants.expected: Casting Berserk is legal (can_play true); Grizzly Bears gets +2/+0 and trample until end of turn (4/2).

variants.label: main2
variants.delta: The step is main2 instead of main1; earlier this turn Grizzly Bears attacked B, went unblocked and dealt its combat damage, so the combat damage step has passed (Grizzly Bears is tapped, B is at 18 life).
variants.expected: Casting Berserk is illegal (can_play false); Berserk stays in A's hand and Grizzly Bears is 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements this restriction as an ActivationPhases parameter on the spell, not as a static ability.

scenarios.title: A static ability stops applying the moment its source leaves the battlefield

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is 3/3 while Glorious Anthem is on the battlefield. B has no creatures.

decisions: B casts Shock targeting A's Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, and keeps priority.
B casts Disenchant targeting Glorious Anthem, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Disenchant resolves, then Shock resolves.

variants.label: anthem_destroyed
variants.expected: Disenchant resolves and Glorious Anthem moves to A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears is 2/2 when Shock resolves, takes 2 damage and moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: anthem_kept
variants.delta: B does not cast Disenchant; Glorious Anthem stays on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears (3/3), which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.
